thread:
mika (DevEx): Heads-up — planning to publish Python & TS SDK v0.12.0 during tonight's 22:00 UTC change window. Includes: async client GA, soft-deprecate legacy sync client, and a TS docstring fix. Any blockers?

sam (Release): sounds good. plan to set dist-tag 'latest' -> 0.12.0 after verification. For the legacy sync deprecation, do we pin 0.11.x as 'legacy' dist-tag and add a hard cutoff date in the changelog? :thinking_face:

viv (QA): Canaries green for both py & ts builds on CI. Found one minor typing break in TS that I already patched (PR #512). Smoke tests: all passing except intermittent flake on macos wheel install — investigating.

mika (DevEx): thanks, viv. sam — yes let's pin legacy 0.11.x and add deprecation blurb. tara, can you draft the release note blurb and the docs banner?

tara (Docs): on it. I'll draft: "Deprecation: legacy sync client will be removed in v0.14.0 (target date 2026-09-01). Migration guide link and examples." Will post draft here in ~30m.

deploy-bot: publish-job scheduled by @mika for 1754449800. Job id: ci-publish-1754449800. Will post status updates.

sam (Release): one extra ask — if we see any signing/403 on PyPI or npm403, do not flip dist-tag. Trigger rollback plan: abort tag flip, republish signed wheel from release-runner, and notify security.

viv (QA): noted. I reproduced a transient 403 on an internal dry-run earlier — turned out to be an expired token on the ephemeral runner. We should validate key fingerprints before flipping.

mika (DevEx): decision: Gate for flip = (1) canary smoke green, (2) wheel/nm fingerprints matching release keys, (3) docs blurb staged. If any fail, hold and escalate.

deploy-bot: ci-publish-1754449800: started...

deploy-bot: ci-publish-1754449800: python wheel upload succeeded. npm package published succeeded.

deploy-bot: ci-publish-1754449800: verification step failed — wheel signature mismatch detected (remote signer != expected). Action: HOLD.

sam (Release): holding flip. Good catch. Do not update dist-tags. We'll mark this release as blocked. Sam -> security + infra: please check key rotation windows.

mika (DevEx): @deploy-bot can you dump the fingerprint that failed? paste the mismatch output here (no secrets).

deploy-bot: verification output: expected fingerprint: SHA256:AB12...FF; observed: SHA256:CD34...AA. (CI metadata: runner=release-runner-7).

viv (QA): runner-7 was redeployed this morning; maybe it pulled a new signing key from staging. I've queued a local re-sign check on a fresh runner.

sam (Release): plan: (A) abort tag flip, (B) revert uploaded npm dist? we can't remove PyPI wheel but we can avoid exposing it via dist-tags, (C) re-run publish from pinned runner with verified key, (D) update release notes with "publish held due to signer verification — republish pending".

tara (Docs): I'll add a short note in the draft and mark the changelog entry as "held" until republish.

mika (DevEx): I'll open an incident ticket for key drift and loop in security. Keep this thread for status. Once republish succeeds, we follow the original gating checklist and then flip 'latest' -> 0.12.0.

sam (Release): agreed. Tagging @security and @infra in the incident.

viv (QA): re-sign check on a clean runner passed locally. Looks like release-runner-7 got a different HSM mapping. I recommend republish from release-runner-2 which has verified keys.

deploy-bot: republish job queued: ci-publish-republish-1754450200 (runner=release-runner-2).

deploy-bot: ci-publish-republish-1754450200: all uploads & signature verifications succeeded.

sam (Release): OK. Conditions met. Proceeding to flip dist-tags in 5m unless objections.

mika (DevEx): no objections. remember to include deprecation note and pin legacy.

deploy-bot: dist-tag update: npm 'latest' -> 0.12.0; npm 'legacy' -> 0.11.x. PyPI: update index metadata to mark 0.12.0 as latest (no destructive delete).

tara (Docs): publishing release notes draft now: includes migration guide link, deprecation banner, and callout about the temporary publish hold (so it's transparent).

sam (Release): closing thread after final checks. Thanks everyone. :tada:
